title: [sweep] Liveness-ledger citation repair — re-cite measured readers for the stale-evidence rows of #7132 + #7133
body:
Sweep pack formed by the triage seat's findings-triage round (2026-08-09, per the SKILL sweep-pack rules; members promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` in this same round). **This card is the single claim/dispatch entry; the member cards are NOT individual dispatch candidates.**

## Shared criterion (same-class test)

Direction-A citation rot only: the ledger row's **verdict re-verified as correct** via a real measured reader, while the **recorded citation** greps to zero at the cited site. The fix shape is uniform and behaviour-free: re-cite the measured reader per E22 with a dated note, in `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` prose. Acceptance surface untouched ⇒ `domain:spec-surface`, changeset patch.

## Members

- #7132 — `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` `props.list.children.*`: 6 of 15 keys cite "ObjectGrid.tsx (audit L15)" with zero occurrences there; measured readers are in the member's table (`bridges/list-view.ts`, `plugin-list/ListView.tsx`, `plugin-view/ObjectView.tsx`).
- #7133 — 6 LIVE rows across `field` / `view` / `page` ledgers citing objectui readers that no longer read the key; measured re-citations in the member's table.

Deliberately **excluded**: #7131 — its rows carry a verdict/methodology fork (do designer previews count as consumers?), not citation rot; held separately by the same round.

## Sweep discipline (binding, from the SKILL five rules)

1. One claim, one PR, `Fixes #7132` + `Fixes #7133`.
2. PR body carries a per-row checklist: ledger row | stale citation (before) | measured re-citation (after), each re-citation **measured at objectui `origin/main` at implementation time** with the reading line quoted — the member tables are the map, not the answer (E9/E24; the shared checkouts run days behind).
3. Zero changes beyond the listed rows; `git diff --stat` must match the checklist file set.
4. Out-of-scope discoveries are filed separately (PD #10), never folded in.
5. **Escalation guard**: if any row's "real reader" turns out to be pass-through-only (a spec-bridge copies the key but no renderer applies it), that row escalates from citation repair to a verdict question — split it out as its own card instead of silently re-citing. #7132's `striped`/`bordered` rows are the known instances of this shape: resolve them by finding an applying reader, or split them into a verdict-question card **before** letting `Fixes #7132` close that member.

## Refs

Axis-③ audit round of 2026-08-09 (session `session_018ffcE95NaMJcL9XJ9VDYgk`), audited at objectstack `4ac12ef4` / objectui `5bfaabde`. Related held cards: #7131 (methodology fork), #7129/#7130 (direction B).
